validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED as a real gas transmission line. The gem.wiki page rests on a SINGLE citation (iranertebat.com, the constructor) backing all 12 refs — that alone is thin, and the URL times out from the verifier (Iranian-host geoblock), so it is NOT citable. But existence is independently corroborated by a SECOND industry party: the project supervisor/engineering consultant Farayand Sazan Energy (fsec-co.com) lists 'Supervision of the Esfarayen–Joghatai–Neghab gas transmission pipeline, 80 km' (verified OK, names the exact line). Constructor (Iran Ertebat) + independent supervisor (fsec-co) both name the pipeline by its three endpoints → real project, built to supply Sabzevar Steel Plant and reinforce the Esfarayen 10-inch branch. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas TRANSMISSION line (Persian 'خط لوله انتقال گاز تقویتی' = reinforcing gas transmission line), gas fuel — both correct. CAVEAT 1 (segment pair, see duplicate note): P6022 (30-inch, 48 km) and P6023 (20-inch, 35 km) are the SAME contractor project — the sources describe one '20- and 30-inch' line of ~70–80 km. GEM split it into two rows by diameter; 48+35=83 km ≈ the 80 km supervisors cite. Legitimate segment split, but the two rows double-count if summed and should cross-reference each other. CAVEAT 2 (province): the sheet's StartState/Province='Razavi Khorasan', but Esfarayen city sits in NORTH Khorasan province (Neqab/Joveyn and Joghatai are in Razavi Khorasan). Sources describe the project overall as 'located in Razavi Khorasan', so this is a minor endpoint-province mismatch, not a hard error.

validity.recommendation: Not a delete — link P6022 (30-inch leg) and P6023 (20-inch leg) as the two diameter-segments of ONE project. Ensure lengths are not summed as if two independent pipelines; add mutual OtherNames/cross-reference.
validity.researcher_notes: P6022 and P6023 carry the identical name 'Esfarayen–Neqab–Joghatai Gas Pipeline' and are the two diameter portions (30-inch/48 km and 20-inch/35 km) of a SINGLE contractor project described by both Iran Ertebat and Farayand Sazan Energy as one '20- and 30-inch' reinforcing line of 70–80 km. This is a segment split, not two distinct pipelines. Flagging so a human confirms the two rows are intentionally segmented and not an accidental double-entry; combined length ~83 km matches the cited ~80 km.

validity.recommendation: Change Owner1 from 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) to National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC) / its transmission arm (IGTC), with client/regional operator Khorasan Razavi Gas Company. Verify before applying.
validity.researcher_notes: Owner is set to 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) at 100%. This is almost certainly WRONG for a DOMESTIC gas transmission reinforcing line feeding a regional steel plant. In Iran, domestic gas transmission and distribution are owned/operated by the National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC) and its subsidiaries (Iranian Gas Transmission Company / provincial gas companies such as Khorasan Razavi Gas Company) — NIOC is the upstream oil/gas producer/exporter (en.wikipedia NIGC page confirms NIGC's role in transmission and distribution). GulfPub's own Iran roster assigns NIGC (not NIOC) to comparable domestic reinforcing/distribution lines (e.g. Iranshahr–Zahedan, Sarkhun–Kerman). No source names NIOC as owner/operator of this specific line; the NIOC value looks like a blanket default GEM applies to Iran rows. Flag for correction to NIGC.

fills.researcher_notes: Supervisor (fsec-co) gives the WHOLE line as 80 km; constructor (search snippet, uncitable iranertebat) gives 70 km construction. GEM's 48 km is the 30-inch leg only (P6023 holds the 35-inch/20-inch leg); 48+35=83 km ≈ 80 km. So the aggregate is corroborated at medium confidence, but the exact 48 km split for the 30-inch leg is NOT independently verified — it is GEM-internal. Ref supports the pipeline+length, not the precise split.

Both the constructor and the supervisor list this line among completed/past projects (project built to supply the already-operating Sabzevar Steel Plant), consistent with status=operating. Medium: no single source gives an explicit commissioning date; treat as operating based on completed-project listings.

The '30-inch' figure is stated only by the constructor page (iranertebat.com), which the verifier cannot reach (ConnectTimeout / geoblock) — uncitable per the no-cite-if-unverifiable rule. The independently reachable supervisor page (fsec-co) names the line and its length but NOT the diameter. Search snippets consistently echo '30 and 20 inch' but all trace back to the single constructor source. Diameter=30 is highly plausible but left UNRESOLVED for lack of a citable independent source.

waypoints.name: Neqab (نقاب), center of Joveyn County, Razavi Khorasan

routes.corridor_desc: Reinforcing gas transmission line running from Esfarayen (North Khorasan province) southward/southeastward into the Joveyn plain of Razavi Khorasan, through Neqab (نقاب, the Joveyn county seat), then west to Joghatai — feeding the Sabzevar Steel Plant to the south and reinforcing the Esfarayen city branch. Overall ~70–80 km. Endpoints are named towns and are firm; the exact vertices between them are NOT sourced, so the corridor is only loosely bounded (town-to-town). Coordinates given are town-centroid approximations (defensible from named places), not surveyed route points.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from the pipeline's own name and the constructor/supervisor descriptions: Esfarayen (North Khorasan), Neqab (نقاب = Joveyn county seat, Razavi Khorasan), Joghatai (Razavi Khorasan), purpose = supply Sabzevar Steel Plant. Coordinates are real town centroids, NOT invented route vertices; no coordinate was fabricated. Because only endpoints/waypoint towns are known and the traced route is not published, suggested RouteAccuracy is 'low' (approximate corridor), a downgrade from the current 'medium'. Note the current sheet StartState/Province='Razavi Khorasan' does not match Esfarayen's actual province (North Khorasan).

summary: P6022 exists (transmission line, confirmed by constructor + independent supervisor); concerns: duplicate/segment-pair with P6023 (same 20/30-inch project), attribution (Owner NIOC should be NIGC), plus province/diameter caveats.
